purpose: Convert measured monitor dimensions and validated pose into 046-compatible physical planes while rejecting pixel-only scale.

activities.label: build physical monitor planes from measured inputs and reject pixel-only scale

queries.question: Can VIZZ build monitor planes only from explicit metric dimensions and pose, refusing Windows pixels as physical scale?

assumptions: The 046 MonitorPlane origin is the physical display centre in a shared metre frame.
A future manual or marker-based procedure can provide monitor pose in that frame.
Nine presented targets per monitor are a protocol fixture, not a claim of optimal human calibration.
kill_tests: Windows pixels, DPI-only data and depth-mask-only data cannot establish metres.
Missing physical dimensions or pose fails closed.
Logical monitor changes are observable through the monitor rectangle and version.
Mouse coordinates never become target truth.
The contract does not start camera, network or screen mutation.
unknowns: Which provider will deliver stable metric eye centres and gaze rays on the current webcam.
The real reprojection error and pose stability of the user desk.
Whether a flat-plane model is adequate for the user's television.
